methodology.text: The validation score was derived by cross-referencing high-volume usage metrics against identified feature gaps and competitive threats to determine the long-term viability and market defensibility of the solution.

executive_summary.text: While the platform demonstrates significant adoption with over 250,000 documents processed, the lack of critical feature depth, such as version-level approvals, limits the severity of the pain point addressed.
The competitive landscape poses a substantial risk, as existing alternatives provide superior automation and broader integration capabilities that current offerings fail to match.
